messages:
anya: Quick sync on geo-slicing pilot roadmap and launch gates. Need crisp criteria for pilot tenants and rollback plan.

sam: We should pick measurable SLIs. Proposal: p95 latency target for region-local requests and p99 stretch for GA.

anya: Agree. Pilot: p95; GA: p99. Also require an ops runbook and acceptance tests.

leo: Fallback policy is key. Define model-variant fallback first, then region fallback order. Ops wants an automated evacuation path.

marta: Customers asking for in-region key control + residency. Can we promise in-region KMS for pilot?

sam: KMS per-region is OK for Dedicated/Private. Hosted pilot gets encryption-at-rest and customer-managed key options where possible. Need legal signoff for claims.

ryan: Add a quality gate: a small prompt-set eval per-customer to ensure quantized/cheaper variants meet parity thresholds before switching.

anya: Draft gating checklist to iterate on:
- p95 latency <= 200ms for 512-token region-local requests
- regional availability >= 99.9% for pilot tenants
- data residency: logs and keys stored in tenant region when requested
- quality gate: <= 3% delta on tenant eval set
- rollback: automated route to global pool with headroom
- observability: per-tenant token cost and trace enabled

leo: Add economic gate: expected cost delta <= 1.5x baseline or explicit finance approval.

marta: Onboarding doc needed: day-1 support matrix, Dedicated/Private requirements, compliance checklist for sales.

sam: Operational limits: cap pilot to 5 tenants; apply shared guardrails (rate limits, quotas). Autoscale policies must prevent noisy-neighbour impacts.

anya: Criteria for pilot tenants: residency need, useful traffic for latency measurement, OK with canary windows.

ryan: Who owns rollout orchestration? Product to coordinate, infra to build routing/fallback and acceptance tests. Need a single owner for invite flow and acceptance signoff.

anya: I'll own product side. Sam, infra to own rollout infra and tests?

sam: Yes. Sprint to prototype policy DSL + routing service. Proposed acceptance tests: connectivity, KV cache warmup, prefix-cache hit >= 60% in 15m.

leo: Schedule a tabletop incident run with SRE and finalize detection/escalation thresholds.

marta: I'll draft the prospect FAQ and compliance checklist and loop in growth.

infra-bot: deploy-batch: routing-dsl-proto deployed to staging (sha: b4c1a2). Runbook template created at /playbooks/geo-slice-pilot.md

anya: Next steps and owners:
- Sam: prototype DSL + acceptance tests (ETA 2w)
- Ryan: eval harness for tenant parity (ETA 1w)
- Marta: onboarding FAQ & compliance checklist (ETA 1w)
- Leo: tabletop incident run w/ SRE (schedule)
- Anya: consolidate launch criteria + shortlist tenants (ETA 3d)

anya: Any objections? :rocket:

sam: :+1:

leo: :+1: will schedule tabletop

marta: :+1: drafting FAQ

anya: Ill post a concise PRD + launch checklist after consolidation. Please reply with wording tweaks for economic gate or measurements and I'll fold them in. :thumbsup:
